embedding_units_note: Generated by embed_batch from the first chunk layout using the loaded model token limit. Index/search must use these units, retain parent_chunk_id and score partial evidence using character coverage.
implementation_status: Expanded ingestion, token-safe embeddings, local Qdrant and vector/BM25/hybrid development evaluation completed. Section hierarchy and payment-rail applicability gaps identified in E18 remain open. Grounded generation and holdout evaluation pending.

retrieval_experiment.status: section-scoped hybrid selected for next context experiment; current CLI defaults unchanged
retrieval_experiment.selection_note: Retain original 400-word-derived units. Section-scoped hybrid and vector recall@5 both reached 86.4%; hybrid recall@20 reached 97.8% versus vector 92.2%, without paired recall regressions against their original baselines. Scoped vector NDCG@5 remains higher (71.8% versus 70.9%). Hybrid fully covers 43/45 cases at twenty, not all 45. Qwen listwise reranking is excluded after two failed controls and 79.7-second latency on its sole completed trial.
retrieval_experiment.scope_note: Experimental evaluators enforce document filters plus publisher-heading exclusions for Non-Mastercard BIN Maestro and QR without a trusted QR setting. Original CLI still has document filters only. Broader section applicability remains unresolved; corrected full-heading rechunking was rejected for lower BM25 recall.
retrieval_experiment.configuration_note: Records the next experiment design. Existing search CLI defaults remain explicit and unchanged; this object does not automatically change retrieval behavior.
